notes.title: Locale Update: YWDH + Launcher Options
notes.notes:
Happy Post-Halloween! We're just in time for that awkward transition between thinking about spooky things and thinking about your family, so, what better time to spend this spooky purgatory than with [b]Grandpa from YWDH[/b].

[h1]YWDH[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now features Japanese localization data, provided by [url=https://twitter.com/loohhoo]Leah Hicks[/url]. You can now experience Grandpa's story in multiple languages.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32612671/7dbe1173b31047591dd140d0e372bdded295d0c9.png[/img]
[*] Has had its UI replaced to be higher resolution and more readable for everyone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32612671/6ed1fc3e0c537cb7d7956c59688fb73aaa5c0c48.png[/img]
[*] The input code for the game now makes camera rotation easier.
[*] The default movement configuration for the game is less likely to get stuck after alt-tabbing,
and is more responsive on controllers with analog input.
[*] Now uses the steamworks API.
[*] General game optimizations to provide a more stable experience.
[/list]

The logic for picking a language is:[olist]
[*] Pick a locale automatically based on your OS language. 
This will be used if there is an error getting this info from steam.
[*] If the launch argument [b]--lang=ja_JP[/b] is provided, it will override [b]1.[/b]
[*] If it can retrieve a language from steam, it will use that. (overrides [b]1. & 2.[/b])
[*] If the launch arguments [b]-language japanese[/b] is provided, it will override [b]3.[/b]
[/olist]

[h1]The Blue Box Launcher[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now features a gear on each game page, allowing you to define options for each.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32612671/fb5e4251703c47fa849a3538263ea68e521a4d48.png[/img]
[*] Now features the ability to provide launch arguments to any games. This can be useful for supplying documented arguments, or engine level arguments. (see: [url=https://docs.unity3d.com/Manual/CommandLineArguments.html]Unity Standalone Player command line arguments[/url])
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32612671/0f890ae24d50009100cf4a725c7590990e7f5435.png[/img]
[*] Now passes command line arguments from steam into each game. Use this sparingly, or for setting localization overrides.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32612671/7dd1a125d58eb95809e591ce154a0827b7920b7e.png[/img]
[*] Disabled unused modules, other minor optimizations that should result in fewer files downloaded.
[*] Uploads game configurations to the Steam Cloud.
[/list]

As always, we hope you like the update. This is just one of many small steps to make our games easier for everyone to enjoy. If you experience any problems with this update, please visit our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/739010/discussions/]support forum[/url] or leave feedback from within the launcher. Localizations will continue to be created and maintained as our games develop, in addition to these short glimpses into the future:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32612671/d0705f08d9ca9bd6072d3f43fc8c87f0b92d19ed.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32612671/fc953307f68d7031378ddd49a1bf7e7d364fac12.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update: [2 New Games] The Retro Content Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32612671/d2045f41ad06cf6880448299c903069faf34fe25.gif[/img]



[h1]The Blue Box Launcher[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added two brand new games:
[*] [b]Normality[/b] - A fast paced arcade style game where you control a futuristic rocket jet and navigate a dark city with all the capabilities of a rocket jet, plus a special time slowing power.
[*] [b]Pube Spider: I Love You[/b] - An alarm clock that doubles as a retro LCD handheld style game about a spider that can't spin it's own web so it has to collect web-like strands while avoiding droplets that make him moist.
[/list]

[h1]Normality[/h1]
[list]
[*] The game hinges upon the titular song [url=https://sphere-2.bandcamp.com/track/normality]Normality by Sphere²[/url] as it was the direct inspiration of it.
[*] Fast paced rocket jet action, and the only thing that can put a stop to it is your inevitable demise.
[/list]
 
[h1]Pube Spider: I Love You[/h1]
[list]
[*] Pube Spider can't spin his own web must instead collect web-like strands things that fall from the sky into his porceilin domain.
[*] Collect as many strands as you can without losing all your lives from getting wet.
[/list]

[h1]Oligocene Snapshot[/h1]
[list]
[*] Prof. Choke had his colors changed and his lab has new lighting.
[*] New song for floating italian confectionary treat by Ultigonio.
[*] New effects for using the dash, which reflects the anxiety you will feel if you miss the perfect opportunity to snap up one of those Oligocene Creatures.
[*] Removed some excessive slides from the intro of the game.
[/list]

[h1]Burger Game[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed joke where if you pressed the order button but you did not specify anything be purchased, then your coworker will drive to the store and back anyway and waste your gas money -- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/739010/discussions/2/1696046342853348832/#c1643167006290942050]as it was confusing to some players[/url].
[/list]

As always, thank you for playing, we hope that you enjoy the update and post your high scores so we can see. We're planning on getting something else ou-

notes.title: Update: Version 1.1 - The Feedback Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32612671/586ffa4708c1a393ab175fd6f739f75f613a0e3f.gif[/img]

Ever since our initial release, we've been hard at work improving things, fixing bugs, planning content updates, and working on new projects we're looking forward to sharing with you. This post documents all the changes that were made available in the update on [b]06/27/19[/b]. [i]Moving forward, patch notes will be made available with/before their corresponding update.[/i] Some changes listed were present in the [u]beta[/u] branch, or were made available as fixes as far back as [b]05/18/18[/b].

[h1]The Blue Box Launcher[/h1]
[list]
[*] Implemented a "Feedback" button that allows players to report bugs, add comments, or share their appreciation for any particular game directly to us. [i]Keep in mind, leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/739010]Steam Review[/url] is the best way to help us get discovered![/i]
[*] UI / scaling improvements.
[*] Now shows video trailers and provides a way to listen to the music from each game.
[/list]

[h1]BurgerGame[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Game Plus now makes it easier to perform encore runs with saves.
[*] The gameplay area has been optimized to reduce load times and improve aesthetics during gameplay.
[*] Achievements were created and defined (see: [i]General Changes[/i])
[/list]

[h1]YWDH[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed the UI to scale uniformly across resolutions.
[*] Added alternate controls for Q/E to rotate the camera.
[*] Fixed lighting to look better in newer versions of the lighting engine.
[/list]

[h1]Llama goes to Market[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added IRC options to release the hellbird onto everyone.
[*] Adjusted haze sorting layers to be more consistent between builds.
[/list]

[h1]General Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] All games export settings were consolidated to make them more consistent with one-another.
[*] A manual has been made available that outlines the core gameplay of each game and has resources for players that require assistance.
[*] A new build process was developed to ease in the delivery of updates.
[*] Older code has been consolidated a fair bit, allowing to reduce each games' on-disk size and overhead.
[*] Achievements early last year, and were working on rolling out more, but had to revert some developments in the interest of stability. [i]Due to recent updates in the game engine, the middleware library we were using to implement steam achievements started to cause unexpected crashes in builds in addition to other complications during development. We are hoping to restore this functionality in the next update.[/i]
[/list]

As always, thank you for playing -- we hope to have something more exciting for you very
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32612671/cac6cce004d48ef1fbfb9ccf06ed2c1c6c2ccae4.png[/img].
